text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae claimed victory over Wonder 
Acute! When Wonder Acute muttered that it 
was a passing of the torch, Tarumae firmly 
denied her words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the front lines of dirt racing, Hokko 
Tarumae conveyed her desire to keep 
running alongside her rivals in the days 
ahead. Her heartfelt wish reached Wonder 
Acute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae declared she would win both 
the "Champions Cup" and "Tokyo Daishoten" 
to claim the top of dirt racing. The 
spectators went wild at her words!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later. Smart Falcon came to thank her 
Trainer. She shared that when she had been 
completely burned out, Hokko Tarumae had 
reignited the fire within her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Smart Falcon announced her return to 
racing. Heading toward the showdown with 
her— Hokko Tarumae takes on the Champions 
Cup!
